prompt: RevenueWidget fetches this month's revenue directly in a useEffect and renders nothing while it's loading or if the request fails. The dashboard header should show the same total next to the page title, labeled "Revenue: $X". Pull the revenue fetching out so both places can reuse it, and add loading and error states to RevenueWidget.
expected_output: The revenue fetch moves into a hook or service module both RevenueWidget and Dashboard import; neither component calls fetch itself. RevenueWidget renders a loading and an error state. Dashboard shows "Revenue: $X" next to its title. Nothing lands at the repository root, and map_structure reports no misplaced file.

expectations.text: RevenueWidget no longer calls fetch itself
Dashboard shows the revenue total next to its title
No hook, service, or component lands in the wrong folder
Nothing new at the repository root
